src='''def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows=[i for i in range(h) if any(x!=bg for x in g[i])]
    bands=[]; cur=[rows[0]]
    for i2 in rows[1:]:
        if i2==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(i2)
        else: bands.append(cur); cur=[i2]
    bands.append(cur)
    if len(bands)!=2: return g
    top,bot=bands
    touch = bot if any(g[r][w-1]!=bg for r in bot) else top
    other = top if touch is bot else bot
    shifts=[]
    for k in range(min(len(touch),len(other))):
        ra,rb=touch[k],other[k]
        ca={c for c in range(w) if g[ra][c]!=bg}
        cb={c for c in range(w) if g[rb][c]!=bg}
        if not ca or not cb: continue
        best=max(sum(1 for c in ca if c+s<w and (c+s) in cb) for s in range(1,w))
        cands={s for s in range(1,w) if sum(1 for c in ca if c+s<w and (c+s) in cb)==best}
        shifts.extend(cands)
    s=Counter(shifts).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for k in range(min(len(touch),len(other))):
        ra,rb=touch[k],other[k]
        ca={c for c in range(w) if g[ra][c]!=bg}
        cb={c for c in range(w) if g[rb][c]!=bg}
        rb_max=max(cb) if cb else -1
        for c in ca:
            cc=c+s
            if cc<w and g[rb][cc]==bg and cc>rb_max:
                g[rb][cc]=1
    return g
